pages.title: Ministry of Industry (Spain) - Wikipedia
pages.excerpt: The**Ministry of Industry and Tourism**(**MINCOTUR**) is the[department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_government_departments)of the[Government of Spain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Government_of_Spain)responsible for designing and implementing the government policy on[industry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Industrial_policy)and[tourism](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tourism_in_Spain). This includes designing the industrial strategy and[development](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Industrialisation), as well as fostering[entrepreneurship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Entrepreneurship)and[small and medium-sized enterprises](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Small_and_medium-sized_enterprises)and defending[industrial property](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Industrial_property). At the international level, these powers are exercised in coordination with the[Ministry of Foreign Affairs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_Foreign_Affairs_(Spain)).[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/
